native_theme_pack_entry_outside.description: Error of a theme package import: an entry would be written outside the extraction folder. name is the entry path.

native_theme_pack_open_failed.description: Error of a theme package import: the chosen file or folder cannot be opened.

native_theme_pack_package_too_big.description: Error of a theme package import: a folder or unpacked archive is over the file count or size cap.

native_theme_pack_run_failed.description: Error of a theme package import: the system tool that unpacks the archive could not start. what is the tool name, error the system's message.

native_theme_pack_temp_failed.description: Error of a theme package import: the folder to unpack into cannot be created.

native_theme_pack_too_large.description: Error of a theme package import: the unpacked size is over the 200 MB cap.

native_theme_pack_too_many_entries.description: Error of a theme package import: the archive lists too many files.

native_theme_pack_tool_failed.description: Error of a theme package import: the unpacking tool rejected the file.

native_theme_pack_tool_timeout.description: Error of a theme package import: unpacking took too long and was stopped.

native_theme_pack_wrong_type.description: Error of a theme package import: the chosen file is neither a zip, a vsix nor a folder.
